name: mri_shoulder
description: Order a shoulder MRI to evaluate rotator cuff tears, labral pathology, biceps tendon, impingement, and shoulder instability.

contrast.description: Contrast requirement — MR arthrography uses intra-articular contrast for labral tears

study_type.description: Standard MRI or MR arthrography with intra-articular gadolinium

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., rotator cuff tear, recurrent dislocation, shoulder pain)

when_to_use: suspected rotator cuff tear (supraspinatus, infraspinatus, subscapularis)
recurrent shoulder dislocation or instability — MR arthrogram for labral tears
chronic shoulder pain with suspected impingement syndrome
pre-operative planning for rotator cuff repair or labral repair
evaluation of long head of biceps tendon pathology

examples.query: Middle-aged patient with shoulder pain, weakness with overhead activities, night pain
